scripts.checks: pnpm lint:fix && pnpm format:fix && pnpm -r checks
scripts.db:clean: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yaml down --volumes && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yaml up --wait db && pnpm --filter backend db:migrate && pnpm --filter backend db:seed
scripts.db:nuke: rm -rf backend/drizzle && pnpm --filter backend db:generate --name init && pnpm db:clean
scripts.map-gen:all: pnpm map-gen galaxy cluster --grid --seed 1234 && pnpm map-gen galaxy spiral --grid --seed 1234 && pnpm map-gen spiral --seed 1234 && pnpm map-gen cluster --seed 1234
scripts.wts: pnpm ci && cp ../text-based-browser-game-1/backend/.env backend/.env && cp ../text-based-browser-game-1/frontend/.env frontend/.env
